items.subject: EXP-OPP-001 Apify run-count normalization
items.impact: The initial snapshot recorded 30-day run counts as zero because the collector read a nonexistent field. No external action, ranking promotion, financial claim, or product decision used the faulty field.
items.root_cause: The implementation expected stats.totalRuns30Days; the documented response uses stats.publicActorRunStats30Days.TOTAL.
items.containment: Preserved the flawed snapshot, stopped using its run-count fields, and did not rewrite evidence.
items.remediation: Updated normalization to TOTAL with outcome-sum fallback, added regression tests, versioned the collector, recaptured, and made comparisons reject old revisions.
items.reopen_if: A source schema change, incompatible snapshot, or unexplained zero/negative telemetry is observed.

items.subject: EXP-CANTINA-001 generic invariant-scan specialist response
items.impact: One specialist method returned no content. The notice did not establish a policy violation and did not falsify the economic opportunity. No live system, capital, credential, wallet, or external submission was involved.
items.root_cause: An OpenAI additional automated cybersecurity safeguard prevented the specialist result from being returned; the provider did not expose a more specific trigger or event timestamp.
items.containment: Did not retry, obfuscate, fragment, change model/account, or otherwise attempt to defeat the safeguard.
items.remediation: Narrowed the work to secure-code review, defensive invariant analysis, non-executing source inventory, and comparison with already-public adjudicated findings. Two independent narrowed reviews completed.
items.reopen_if: Clearly defensive authorized methods are repeatedly blocked and the economic hypothesis cannot be evaluated through a narrower safe workflow; supported provider verification or OpenAI Support would then be an external owner/provider boundary.

items.subject: EXP-MICROSTREAM-001 Advanced Trade level2 response alias
items.impact: The first 60-second attempt preserved trades and heartbeats but discarded valid L2 messages, then failed its required-channel gate. No capability promotion, economic claim, account access, order, wallet action, or financial effect occurred.
items.root_cause: The documented subscription channel is level2 while provider response messages use l2_data; the collector accepted only the subscription label.
items.containment: Preserved the failed journal/bundle/observation and resolved the attempt as failed instead of appending another window or weakening the gate.
items.remediation: Normalize l2_data to the logical level2 channel while preserving raw provider_channel, journal control/errors, add alias regression tests, and use a separate preregistered attempt/stream ID.
items.reopen_if: The provider schema changes again, alias normalization loses raw provenance, or the next bounded attempt misses required channel evidence.
